bullets.text: Telco AI Startups Surge - The telco AI market is projected to skyrocket from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
HCLTech Acquires HPE Unit - HCLTech's $160 million acquisition of HPE's Telco Solutions aims at AI-driven network automation.
5G Strategies Diverge - AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile adopt distinct 5G strategies, impacting future network performance.
AI and Wi-Fi Convergence - AI will enhance Wi-Fi networks, making them smarter and more responsive by 2026.
6G Innovation on the Horizon - 6G will embed intelligence directly into the radio layer, reshaping network operations.
Huawei's Agentic AI Vision - Huawei emphasizes AI agents for operational efficiency and new revenue streams in telecom.
Geospatial Analytics Revolution - Geospatial data is now a strategic asset for telecom network planning and customer insights.
AI Infrastructure Predictions - By 2026, intelligent infrastructure design will be crucial for competitive advantage in AI.
